'''Pyros''', originally known as '''Ord Pyros''', was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].

==History==
Ord Pyros was colonized by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as an [[Ordnance/Regional Depot/Legends|Ordnance/Regional Depot]] sometime before the [[Pius Dea Era]].<ref name="TEGtW" />

Pyros planet was raided by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] operatives shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. The raid was met with intense resistance, contrary to initial reconnaissance.
